raw_segments.text: No single soul can we set eye on, but in all safe reason he must have some attendance.
Though his humor was nothing but mutation, I, and that from one bad thing to worse, not
frenzy, not absolute madness could so far have raved, to bring him here alone.
Although perhaps it may be heard at court that such as we cave here, hunt here, are
outlaws, and in time may make some stronger head, the witchy hearing, as it is like him,
might break out and swear he'd fetch us in.
Yet Ist not probable to come alone, either he so undertaking or they so suffering.
